studies.title: Khipu, the knotted record
studies.caption: Cords of coloured cotton, knotted in a decimal code, record census counts, tribute and perhaps narratives; specialists read them aloud.
studies.prompt: Extreme close study of an Andean record keeper holding a cotton khipu about1450CE: one main cord with many hanging colored subsidiary cords, grouped knots at different levels clearly visible; woven tunic behind, stone wall soft in distance. No written ledger or modern beads.
